dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト) - screen handler for P02H window, patient registration subsystem
evidence: COPY P02H.INC and many P02*.INC screen copybooks
EXEC CICS/SQL absent; GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL MCP framework

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - patient registration screen P02H, handling insurance number selection list
purpose.summary: This program is a screen handler (P02H window) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It manages a list-selection screen for insurance numbers (保険番号) in the patient registration (患者登録) subsystem. It handles initialization, screen editing, cursor positioning, and user input events such as row selection from a list widget.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (41 copybooks) for screen layouts and shared areas
MCP framework (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WIDGET) - ORCA GUI middleware
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen handling
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern for state persistence across screen transitions
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP database access
verdict.notes: Japanese comments are garbled due to Latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system. Program type classified as online-cics by analogy since it uses an event-driven GUI middleware (MCP) rather than CICS, but the pattern is equivalent. Five lines slightly exceed column 72 (long_lines_over_72=5), consistent with fixed format with minor overruns.
